compute_3d_box_iou: compute the 3D bounding box IoU and 2D bird's eye view IoU between two sets of 8 corner points
compute_2d_box_iou: compute the 2D bounding box IoU between two axis-aligned boxes given as xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax tuples
generate_3d_box_corners: generate 3D box corner coordinates from box size, heading angle, and center position using roty rotation
compute_generalized_3d_box_giou: compute the generalized 3D box IoU tensor between batches of boxes with optional rotated box intersection
convert_coordinate_system: flip point cloud coordinates from depth sensor format X-right,Y-forward,Z-up to camera format X-right,Y-down,Z-forward
